milestones.description: Uses position_inside_box because this is a navigation/movement task requiring the player to physically enter the building entrance zone where stone_stairs are placed (x=4-6, y=0, z=1). The box [3,0,0]-[7,2,2] covers the entrance doorway area. Player spawns at (0,0,-1) which is outside this box, requiring intentional movement east and north.

Uses position_inside_box because the player must physically enter the cracked_stone_bricks hallway (interior x=4-6, z=2-5) to proceed deeper into the building. The hallway walls at x=3, x=7, and z=6 are all cracked_stone_bricks. Box encompasses the hallway including wall positions.

Uses position_inside_box because the player must enter the enclosed gray room (interior x=0-2, z=4-8) through the left doorway at x=3, z=4-5. Light_gray_concrete_powder lines the walls at x=0 and x=2, y=1-2, z=4-8. The room is walled off and not visible from the hallway without entering.

Uses position_inside_box because the player must enter the enclosed pink room (interior x=8-12, z=4-9) through the right doorway at x=7, z=4-5. Pink_stained_glass_pane divider is at x=8-12, y=1-2, z=6. The room is walled off and requires entering through the doorway.

Uses position_inside_box because the player must walk deeper into the gray room to the carpet area (x=0-2, y=0, z=6-8). The carpet is on the floor in the back half of the gray room, requiring the player to navigate past the concrete powder walls. Box covers the carpet zone specifically.

Uses position_inside_box because the player must enter the separate bedroom (interior x=0-2, z=10-15) through the 1-block doorway at x=1, z=9 from the gray room. Purple_bed is at x=1, y=0, z=11-12. The bedroom is a distinct enclosed room only accessible through the gray room.

Uses inventory_has because mining pink_concrete with an iron pickaxe causes the block to drop as an item which enters the player's inventory. The pink_concrete wall at x=8-12, y=0-2, z=9 seals the back storage room. Player must mine at least 1 block to create a passage to the green_concrete storage.

Uses inventory_has because mining a redstone_block with an iron pickaxe (required minimum tier) causes it to drop as an item which enters the player's inventory. The redstone_block is at x=1, y=1, z=15 embedded in the back wall of the bedroom. Iron pickaxe is provided via /give.

Uses inventory_has because mining green_concrete with an iron pickaxe causes the block to drop as an item which enters the player's inventory. The green_concrete at x=9-11, y=0-1, z=11-12 is in a sealed storage room only accessible after mining through the pink_concrete wall at z=9.
